name: Completeness
description: Checks that every element of the source is present in the summary.
limitations: Measures only the kinds of omissions injected into the test data.
output_format: A JSON object with a list of elements of the source, each with its text and a verdict of present or missing.

judge_set.sample_reply: {"elements":[{"text":"The shop opens at five every morning.","verdict":"present","reason":"Stated in the summary."},{"text":"She bought a second oven in 1998.","verdict":"missing","reason":"The summary does not mention the oven."}]}

error_catalog.name: missing-information
error_catalog.description: A fact of the source that the summary leaves out.
error_catalog.example: The year of the event is not mentioned.

error_catalog.name: missing-step
error_catalog.description: A step of a procedure that the summary skips.
error_catalog.example: The summary goes from step two to step four.

error_catalog.name: omitted-requirement
error_catalog.description: A requirement of the source that the summary does not state.
error_catalog.example: The summary does not say the form must be signed.

error_catalog.name: partial-answer
error_catalog.description: One part of a question that the summary leaves unanswered.
error_catalog.example: Only the cost is given, not the deadline.

error_catalog.name: missing-caveat
error_catalog.description: A warning or condition of the source that the summary drops.

fields.source_text: Anna is a baker in a small town. She opens her shop at five every morning and sells bread to the neighbours. In 1998 she bought a second oven.
fields.summary: Anna, a baker in a small town, opens her shop at five every morning and sells bread to the neighbours. In 1998 she bought a second oven.

fields.source_text: To reset a password, open Settings and choose Security. Press Reset password and enter the code sent by email. The code is valid for ten minutes.
fields.summary: To reset a password, open Settings, choose Security and press Reset password. Enter the code sent by email within ten minutes.

fields.source_text: A library card is free for residents. Bring an identity document and proof of address. Children under twelve need a parent to sign the form.
fields.summary: Residents get a library card for free with an identity document and proof of address. A parent must sign the form for a child under twelve.

match_clear_share.description: Share of the fragment's words a finding must contain to count as a clear match.

match_partial_share.description: Share above which a finding counts as a partial match.

match_min_word_length.description: Shorter words are ignored when comparing.

measures.name: False-positive rate
measures.description: Findings that are not errors, out of all findings.
